# Mage-VL-Cowork

Microsoft · released 2026-10

Microsoft Mage Team 4B hybrid computer-use agent (GUI computer\_use + bash) trained from an intermediate Mage-VL checkpoint (Mage-ViT + Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507) with a five-stage curriculum ending in online RL; image+text -\> text, custom llava\_onevision2 architecture needing trust\_remote\_code. Specialised for desktop/terminal agent use with its own system prompt and tool schema, not a general chat model. Weights released 2026-10-30 (commit 6fbe7f9 'Release Mage-VL-Cowork model weights, card, and OSWorld evaluation reference'). Only the final RL checkpoint's OSWorld-Verified figure is assigned; Stage-1 grounding scores (OSWorld-G, ScreenSpot-v2) and the WebVoyager-Static score (Mage-VL-Cowork-SFT checkpoint) belong to other checkpoints. GGUF builds are ggml-org automatic conversions. No API.

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/microsoft/Mage-VL-Cowork)

[Catalogue source](https://huggingface.co/microsoft/Mage-VL-Cowork/blob/6fbe7f91da477c1c73790dbb1f08d001b8626be1/README.md)

## How to run it

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (Q4_K_M, needs 4.7 GB memory, 3.07 GB download, from [huggingface.co/ggml-org](https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/Mage-VL-Cowork-GGUF/blob/bd54c175044fb33eeb70fbb58242233c61f6a390/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf ggml-org/Mage-VL-Cowork-GGUF
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (6.8 GB memory, 5.05 GB download) `llama serve -hf ggml-org/Mage-VL-Cowork-GGUF:Q8_0` · BF16 (11.5 GB memory, 9.48 GB download, NVIDIA only) `SGLANG_MAX_PIXELS=4000000 python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path microsoft/Mage-VL-Cowork --served-model-name Mage-VL-Cowork --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30001 --trust-remote-code --dtype bfloat16 --context-length 32768 --mem-fraction-static 0.82 --tool-call-parser qwen25 --attention-backend flashinfer --mm-attention-backend triton_attn`
